unsupported_source_or_alias_identity_hol.evaluation_finding: None of the 67 identities are saved publisher articles in the repository. They represent uncaptured third-party URLs, social media links, video pages, or search hit tokens. No demonstrable source-use reuse basis exists in saved workspace material without prospective capture.
unsupported_source_or_alias_identity_hol.required_for_resolution: Requires an exact original publisher article capture and source-specific reuse/extent evidence under a separately authorized bounded scope. Social/video/homepage/media tokens are not articles; rewriting an alias into an unexposed identity without reservation is strictly forbidden.

history_or_component_identity_holds.evaluation_finding: Evaluated against source-only historical bundles and existing datasets. All 10 identities share named weather episodes (Quinta, Tisoy, Maymay/Habagat), continuing rainfall sequences (Ofel/Pepito, Pangasinan continuous rain), or government flood-control programmes/inquiries (Bayanihan sa Estero, Bulacan ghost project inspection, Oplan Kontra Baha, Mindoro asset) already present in historical training/validation data. Different publication dates, reporting districts, phrasing, or article URLs do not establish event or reporting independence.
history_or_component_identity_holds.required_for_resolution: Provide saved source-only evidence separating an actual named weather episode, physical asset, or reporting chain from already exposed components. Different dates, districts, wording, or article identifiers alone do not clear a relationship. Otherwise retain the hold.

unqualified_metadata_identity_holds.evaluation_finding: Fragmentary snippet tokens only; no complete publisher article body or publication evidence exists in saved material.
unqualified_metadata_identity_holds.required_for_resolution: An exact complete supported original article identity and verified publication evidence within January 1, 2017 - October 14, 2026 before capture; snippet fragments or ambiguous tokens alone do not qualify.

reference_type_or_positive_capacity_iden.evaluation_finding: Source-contained mentions lack supported explicit six-class positive location entity or coherent positive mixed passage; generic references (agencies, regional water bodies, bare untyped province names) do not qualify as positive place entities.
reference_type_or_positive_capacity_iden.required_for_resolution: Source-contained explicit type and sense for the place, a coherent location-bearing original mixed passage, and supported original extent. Unknown references stay unscored.

target_language_capacity_identity_holds.evaluation_finding: English-only report (burst pipe) without Taglish lexical mixing clauses in body. Existing English quota is already full (30/30).
target_language_capacity_identity_holds.required_for_resolution: An unchanged original passage with Filipino clauses and untranslated English common or technical material, plus a complete six-class positive location; English-only reports and names alone do not fill the remaining Taglish quota.
